title: Resolve SBI/SBIC entities and model actual capital, Evernorth custody and Binance XRP withdrawal reopening
decisions: Confirm Circle SBI Japan K.K. English name / SBI Circle Holdings K.K. Japanese name and 50/50 ratio; preserve no-significant-results caveat.
Keep regional SBIC entities distinct from SBI Holdings and the SBI-Circle JV.
Represent SBI's Ripple, Circle, Evernorth, SBI Ripple Asia, SBI Remit, retail and Bitbank relationships separately.
Track Evernorth cash purchases, in-kind XRP, Ripple contribution, attributed wallets, unattributed outflows, debt, equity line, share classes and encumbrance separately.
Treat 370.35M Evernorth XRP outside attributed wallets as an attribution gap, not a sale, DeFi deployment or collateral pledge.
Separate Circle Mint gross flows, supply, Coinbase distribution costs, revenue and profit.
Treat Binance 06:00–09:00 UTC XRP withdrawals as scheduled until actual service and transaction evidence.
No directional forecast or feature admission; use synchronized event studies and controls.
Retain minority objections and independent red-team review.
Keep PR #1442 open and unmerged; explicit user approval required.

measurements: XRP withdrawal availability and first transactions
Binance wallet balances and net exchange flows
Coinbase, Upbit, Bithumb, SBI VC Trade and Bitbank flows
spot depth, spreads, volume and basis
event_study.causal_policy: No causal attribution from one before/after price move.
